Serves the card entry symbol ManiSkill.mani_skill.envs.tasks.empty_env:EmptyEnv (Empty-v1), the bare ManiSkill scene with the default Panda; the other card entries are the RotateCube levels and SceneManipulation. No DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the gymnasium family-config GymnasiumDriver expresses this environment through cap.world.step/reset/seed. Only the package fake backend was run; the upstream sim path (gymnasium.make('Empty-v1') after importing mani_skill.envs) was not run because ManiSkill, SAPIEN and PyTorch are not installed here and package code never imports the clone. Fidelity is F0: the fake advances joint positions kinematically and clears qvel, with no PhysX contacts, forces, actuator, sensor or noise model, and it was not compared with upstream. The observation has the 18 numbers of the state observation (qpos and qvel of the nine Panda joints); no camera image, depth or point cloud is returned. The zero start joint state and the mimic finger relation are placeholders in fake.py, marked there, and the 200000-step time limit is modelled but not exercised by a test. Expected warnings are G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge stores the pending seed and makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived ticks, seed (twice) and action.values inputs; G4 reported no warnings. The package is model-authored and unreviewed, and no hardware run is claimed.
